evidence.snippet: We introduce LLMTabBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on tabular classification under low-data conditions.

claire_radar.motivation: Supervised classification on tabular data remains a central machine learning task, but its dependence on large labeled datasets limits its applicability in data-scarce settings.
